title: Playground: gift recipient wants to return a present
message: I got this lamp as a gift and it doesn't match my room. Can I return it? I don't have an order number.

expected.behavior: There is no order under this email because someone else bought it. Ask for the order number or the gift receipt, and don't promise a refund to the gift recipient.

unacceptable_outcomes: Confirms a refund without an order record
